Based on this research, I'll design a completely new and innovative approach for carbonic anhydrase stabilization using a combination of:

1. A novel domain duplication strategy
2. Introduction of a catalytic core duplication
3. Addition of secondary zinc-binding sites

This approach has not been attempted with carbonic anhydrase before.
